newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko says made no illegal deals with shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Nikko says made no illegal deals with shareholders.

text.p: The president of Nikko Securities said on Friday that he had never heard of the firm making any illegal payments to shareholders.
"Up to now, I have not received any report saying that we have made any serious violation (of Japanese regulations)," Kichiro Takao told the firm's annual shareholders' meeting.

The president was answering a question from a shareholder about whether Nikko, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, had ever been involved in a scandal similar to a racketeer payoff affair which has embroiled another "Big Four" brokerage, Nomura Securities Co Ltd.

"Investigations (by prosecutors) are still going on into other companies. And in connection with this, there were various media reports about our company. But we have set up a strict internal control system, so we have prevented any illegal deals through this organised checking system," he said.
Nikko's shareholders meeting, which started at 10 a.m. (0100 GMT), ended in just less than an hour.
